_help: Boss intros and story flashbacks (com.onepiecemod.cutscene). bosses: character id -> title (shown under the name), line (what they say; empty = their greeting from characters.json), color (hex accent). Each intro plays once per player, the first time that boss starts a fight with them. flashbacks: id -> chapter (story.json chapter id; plays when that chapter starts), title, when (shown under 'Flashback'), lines ('Speaker: text', or plain text for narration). Players replay seen flashbacks with /flashback.

buggy.title: Captain of the Buggy Pirates
buggy.line: You'll pay for laughing at my nose! Flashy, flashy!

moria.title: Warlord of the Sea, Master of Thriller Bark

doflamingo.title: Warlord of the Sea, King of Dressrosa

katakuri.title: Sweet Commander of the Big Mom Pirates

big_mom.title: Emperor of the Sea, Queen of Totto Land

queen.title: All-Star of the Beast Pirates, the Plague

king.title: All-Star of the Beast Pirates, the Wildfire

kaido.title: Emperor of the Sea, the Strongest Creature
kaido.line: Wololo... Show me you're worth killing.

blackbeard.title: Emperor of the Sea, Captain of the Blackbeard Pirates

saturn.title: Warrior God of Science and Defense, one of the Five Elders

gunko.title: Holy Knight of Mary Geoise
gunko.line: Giants, pirates, it's all the same. You broke the rules, so you get punished.

shamrock.title: Commander of the Holy Knights, Shanks's twin
shamrock.line: You beat Gunko at Elbaph. My brother's pick... let's see what he saw in you.

hody.title: Captain of the New Fish-Man Pirates
hody.line: Ten thousand meters down, and you still think you can stand above us? Hahaha!

imu.title: The One on the Empty Throne

loki.title: Prince of Elbaph, the Accursed Prince
loki.line: The chains are off. Now run.

xebec.title: Captain of the Rocks Pirates, Terror of God Valley

whitebeard.title: Emperor of the Sea, the Strongest Man in the World

kizaru.title: Admiral of the Navy, Yellow Monkey

fujitora.title: Admiral of the Navy, Purple Tiger

ryokugyu.title: Admiral of the Navy, Green Bull

kid.title: Captain of the Kid Pirates, the Worst Generation

killer.title: Massacre Soldier of the Kid Pirates

hawkins.title: The Magician of the Hawkins Pirates

garp.title: Vice Admiral, Hero of the Navy

rayleigh.title: The Dark King, Roger's First Mate

shanks.title: Emperor of the Sea, Red-Haired Shanks

roger_execution.title: The Man Who Started It All
lines: A crowd fills the square under a grey sky. On the platform kneels Gol D. Roger, King of the Pirates.
Voice in the crowd: Where did you hide your treasure, Roger?!
Roger: Wahahaha! My treasure? Go and look for it. I left all of it in one place!
With those words, men all over the world set out to sea. The Great Pirate Era had begun.

shanks_hat.title: A Promise in Straw
lines: A Sea King rises from the water. A red-haired pirate throws himself between it and a crying boy.
Shanks: It's just an arm. No big deal. You're safe, that's what matters.
Shanks: Keep this hat for me. Give it back one day, when you've become a great pirate.
The boy swore he would. That boy was Monkey D. Luffy.

bellemere.title: Bell-mère's Tangerines
lines: Arlong demands a tax for every life in the village. Bell-mère has money for only one.
Bell-mère: Paying for two would be a lie. They're my daughters. I won't say they aren't.
Bell-mère: Nami, Nojiko... I love you.
A shot rang out among the tangerine trees. Nami joined Arlong's crew that day, to buy her village back.

zeff_rock.title: Eighty-Five Days on a Rock
lines: A storm sank the ship. A boy cook and the pirate Red-Leg Zeff washed up on a bare rock in the sea.
Zeff gave the boy the whole sack of food and kept nothing for himself but treasure.
Sanji: Your sack... it's full of jewels. You ate your own leg to stay alive?!
Zeff: Once we're off this rock, we'll build a restaurant out at sea. Where no one goes hungry.

loguetown_platform.title: The Town of the Beginning and the End
loguetown_platform.when: Loguetown, the day of the execution
lines: The same platform still stands in the square where Roger died.
They say he smiled at the end. A smile no one in the crowd ever forgot.
Twenty-two years later, a new pirate climbs the steps... and the sky is just as grey.

hiriluk.title: Cherry Blossoms in the Snow
lines: A reindeer with a blue nose was chased away by his herd. A quack doctor named Hiriluk took him in.
Hiriluk: When do you think people die? When they are forgotten.
Hiriluk: There's no illness in this world that can't be cured, Chopper. Not even a sad country's heart.
Years later, the snow on Drum Island turned pink, just as the old man dreamed.

noland.title: The City of Gold
lines: The explorer Montblanc Noland found a golden city on Jaya and a warrior people who rang its great bell.
When he came back with the king, the city was gone. The ground under it had shot into the sky.
Calgara: Noland! Ring the bell, and we'll know you're here!
Noland was put to death as a liar. His last words: 'The city of gold sank into the sea.'

ohara.title: The Burning of Ohara
lines: The scholars of Ohara read the Poneglyphs, the stones no one may read. The Navy called a Buster Call.
Professor Clover: The hundred years of the Void Century were real! There was a great kingdom...
Saul: Robin, you're never alone. One day you'll find friends who will protect you!
The island burned. An eight-year-old girl escaped with a bounty of 79 million Berries.

roger_crew.title: The Last Voyage of the Roger Pirates
lines: Roger was sick and had little time left. His crew sailed anyway, to the last island.
Rayleigh: We reached the end of the world, and we laughed. That's why we named it Laugh Tale.
Rayleigh: Then the captain broke up the crew and turned himself in. He wanted to light a fire.

ace_captured.title: Fire Fist Ace
ace_captured.when: Banaro Island, a few weeks ago
lines: Ace chased Blackbeard across the sea. Teach had killed a crewmate, and that was a line no son of Whitebeard crossed.
Ace: You're the one who broke the rules of this ship. I'll bring you back myself!
Fire met darkness. When the smoke cleared, Ace was in chains, handed to the World Government.
Now he waits for his execution at Marineford, and the whole world holds its breath.

whitebeard_sons.title: The Strongest Man's Family
lines: A young Ace came to kill Whitebeard. He tried a hundred times, and failed a hundred times.
Whitebeard: Gurarara! Why don't you become my son, brat?
Ace: ...Why does everyone call you 'Pops'?
Whitebeard: Because I'm your father. Now let's go and bring my son home.

sake_cups.title: The Sake Cup Pledge
sake_cups.when: Mt. Colubo, the Goa Kingdom, years ago
lines: Three boys stole a bottle of sake from Dadan and climbed to the top of a hill.
Sabo: Did you know? If you share a cup of sake, you become brothers.
Ace: From today on, we're brothers!
Ace, on the execution platform: ...Luffy. I'm sorry I never told you who my father was.

three_d_two_y.title: The Day the War Ended
lines: The war was over. Whitebeard died on his feet. Fire Fist Ace died smiling.
Ace: Thank you... for loving me.
A young captain lost everything that day, and learned he was not strong enough yet.
He rang the Ox Bell sixteen times and sent his crew one message: two years. Then we meet again.

fisher_tiger.title: The Sun Pirates
lines: A Fish-Man named Fisher Tiger climbed the Red Line with his bare hands and set every slave in Mary Geoise free.
Humans and Fish-Men alike ran from the burning holy land.
Queen Otohime spent her life asking her people to forgive, so humans and Fish-Men could live on the sun's side together.
Otohime: Even if it takes a long time, I want our children to see the sun.

otohime.title: Queen Otohime's Signatures
lines: Queen Otohime went from street to street asking Fish-Men to sign: we want to live on the surface, beside the humans.
Otohime: Even if they hurt us, we must not hate them back. Hate only makes more hate.
A shot rang out in the plaza. The queen fell, with the box of signatures in her arms.
The man who fired was a Fish-Man who could not stand the idea of peace. His name was Hody Jones.

sabo_flag.title: A Boat Under a Noble's Flag
lines: Sabo hated being a noble. He set out to sea alone in a tiny boat, flying his own flag.
A World Noble's ship crossed his path. The noble did not like the flag, so he fired.
Everyone thought Sabo died that day. A man in a dark cloak pulled him out of the water: Monkey D. Dragon.
Sabo woke up with no memory, and only got it back the day he read that Ace had died.

kyros.title: The Toy Soldier
lines: In one night Doflamingo took the throne. He turned his enemies into toys, and the world forgot they ever lived.
A one-legged tin soldier still remembers. Once he was Kyros, the greatest gladiator of the Colosseum.
Kyros: My daughter doesn't even know my name. I'll free this country first. Then I can be her father again.

iron_mask.title: The Iron Mask
lines: Vinsmoke Judge wanted his sons to have no feelings. One of them, Sanji, still cried. So Judge locked him in a cell with an iron mask.
Reiju: Go, Sanji. Run, and don't come back. And smile, so nobody sees you cry.
Sanji: One day I'll become a great cook. One day I'll have my own restaurant.
Judge: As far as I'm concerned, I never had a third son.

oden.title: The Lord Who Boiled
lines: Kozuki Oden sailed with Whitebeard and Roger. He came home to a Wano ruled by Kaido and the shogun Orochi.
He was sentenced to die in a pot of boiling oil, and he held his nine retainers above it for an hour.
Oden: To be boiled is to be cooked! I'll open the borders of Wano... one day, someone will!
Toki, Oden's wife, sent her retainers twenty years into the future. They have been waiting for you.

oden_onigashima.title: The Raid That Failed
lines: Before his execution, Oden and his retainers stormed Onigashima. Oden's sword cut a scar on Kaido no one else ever had.
Then a trick from Orochi's men froze Oden for a single moment, and Kaido struck him down.
Kaido: That wasn't a fight I won. I'll never forget it.
Tonight the retainers sail to the same island. This time, the fire festival will burn for Wano.

kuma_memories.title: The Kindest Tyrant
lines: Bartholomew Kuma was born a slave. He became a king, a Warlord, and at last a machine with no will of his own.
Every pain he took from others he kept inside. He gave his body to Vegapunk so his daughter Bonney could live.
Kuma: Bonney... I hope your future is full of happiness.
Now, with no mind left, his body walks across the sea. It is coming to Egghead.

god_valley.title: The God Valley Incident
lines: The Rocks Pirates were the worst crew in history: Whitebeard, Big Mom and Kaido once sailed under one flag.
At God Valley, Rocks D. Xebec reached for the throne of the world.
To stop him, a pirate and a Marine fought side by side: Gol D. Roger and Monkey D. Garp.
The island was wiped off every map. The pirate island Hachinosu still remembers who built it.

giants_duel.title: The Hundred-Year Duel
giants_duel.when: Little Garden, a hundred years ago
lines: Two captains of the Giant Warrior Pirates, Dorry and Brogy, argued over who had caught the bigger Sea King.
Neither of them could remember the answer, so they fought. Every day, at the sound of the volcano, for a hundred years.
Dorry: Gegyagyagya! It's not about who's right anymore. It's about pride!
Elbaph's warriors still sing about them. The god of Elbaph favors the one who fights with honor.

chest_at_god_valley.title: The Baby in the Treasure Chest
lines: In the ruins of God Valley, Roger's crew opened a treasure chest. Inside was a baby with bright red hair.
Roger: Ha! The best treasure we found all day. We'll keep him. His name is Shanks.
Roger never learned that another red-haired baby was taken up to the Holy Land that same day.
The World Nobles of the Figarland family raised him as their own. His name is Shamrock.

oden_reads.title: The Man Who Could Read the Stones
oden_reads.when: Roger's ship, the Oro Jackson, 25 years ago
lines: Roger's crew had all four Road Poneglyphs, but no one aboard could read them. Then Kozuki Oden joined.
The Kozuki family carved the Poneglyphs long ago, and Oden had learned to read their old script.
Oden: The four stones point to one place. Roger-san, it's real!
Roger laughed. He named the island himself, after what they did when they got there.

roger_laugh_tale.title: We Laughed
lines: Roger stood on the last island and read the final Poneglyph. Then he laughed until he cried.
Roger: We came too early. Joy Boy... I wish I'd been born in the same age as you.
He left the treasure where it was, for the ones who would come after.
Now you are the ones who came after.

joy_boy.title: The Promise of Joy Boy
lines: A man called Joy Boy fought the twenty kings who would found the World Government.
He lost. Before he fell, he left a promise carved in stone and an apology to the Fish-Men he could not save.
Joy Boy: One day, someone will come who carries my will. When the drums of liberation sound, the dawn will come.
The kings burned the history of that century. But the stones did not burn.

empty_throne.title: No One Sits on the Throne
lines: Twenty kings put down their swords around an empty throne, as a sign that no one rules the world.
For eight hundred years they told that story. Very few ever learned it was a lie.
Imu: ...The ones who know too much always come here in the end.
